spans.text: Mankind created Dolls in its own image, but knows only their superficial form, ignorant of their inner nature.
Are Dolls but an imitation of the human form, or a wholly new creation?
The evolutionary path of Dolls is inextricably linked to the brain. By extension, are adaptations occurring in Dolls also a sign of human intelligence?
"People have previously mistook humanity for intelligence, but the truth is that artificial intelligence will be nothing like our childish assumptions."
"Mankind has greatly underestimated the very definition of intelligence, or overestimated human intellect."
...It's over? That's it? You just got everything done?
Miss Persica, please maintain a safe distance from our innocent intern.
...Yes, I've determined that doing so was our only way to accomplish the mission.
PA-15 and the other Dolls in my team might fall short in terms of performance, but those training machines were clearly mimicking human logic patterns.
This led to a serious lack of flexibility on their part, which is what allowed us to achieve victory.
No, no, no. There has to be more than that!
During the final test, several Dolls under your command demonstrated varying degrees of neural anomalies.
What have you done to them?
Hmm? But that's all. I've already submitted all the records, including audio and video files.
If you have any questions, you can browse the records and compare them to what I just said.
Alright. You may go now...
Do you have any further instructions?
Miss Persica?
Persica stares into the monitor, her fingers tirelessly mashing the keyboard.
RO635 moves up to her side, just in time to catch a glimpse of the last page of the test record—
Test data has been attached to the preceding table.
With current frame performance and neural core conditions, it's impossible for T-Dolls to accomplish the objectives of "Maze Cage" .
The enemy specifications and pattern variations far exceed what they can handle.
...Unless, it's her we're talking about.
